name: Saxon Hotel, Villas & Spa
insider_take: This legendary Johannesburg sanctuary sits on 10 acres of manicured gardens in exclusive Sandhurst, where Nelson Mandela once held private meetings and where royalty still retreats behind ivy-covered walls.
whats_special: The Saxon's claim to fame extends beyond luxury—it's where Mandela penned parts of his autobiography and where the hotel's art collection includes pieces worth over $1 million. Each villa features original South African artworks, and the property maintains one of the country's most impressive wine cellars with over 500 selections.
pro_tip: Book the Mandela Platinum Suite to stay in the exact room where the former president worked on his memoirs, complete with his personal library still intact.
dont_miss: The Saxon's legendary high tea served in the same conservatory where international dignitaries once dined, and a sunset walk through the sculpture garden featuring works by renowned South African artists. The spa's African potato body wrap uses indigenous ingredients found nowhere else in the world.
pros: Award-winning spa with comprehensive wellness treatments
Private villa accommodations with exclusive gardens
Exceptional fine dining restaurant with gourmet cuisine
Luxurious boutique property with personalized service
cons: Intimate boutique size with limited room inventory
